sourceOfTruth: This file is the source of truth for which Claude Code plugins workstation install enables at user scope. install.ps1 reads it; add or remove names here. Plugins come from Anthropic's official marketplace (claude-plugins-official). DansPC's exact 23-plugin set is not stored elsewhere in this repo; the names below are that known set plus desktop-commander. On a PC, claude plugin list --json shows what is already installed.
